skill.summary: Monitor iMessage/SMS conversations and auto-respond based on configurable rules, AI prompts, and rate-limiting conditions. Use when you need to automatically reply to specific contacts with AI-generated responses based on conversation context. Also use when the user asks to manage auto-responder settings, contacts, prompts, or view status/history.
